! Title: Fixture popup index source
||popunder.example^$popup
||another-popup.example^$popup,third-party
$popup,domain=host.example
! A DNS-style entry: the popup-only role makes every host rule a popup destination.
||sub.dns-popup.example^
! Not destinations: a path, a rule scoped to source sites, an address prefix, a suffix.
||path-popup.example/landing$popup
||scoped-popup.example^$popup,domain=source.example
||109.248.$popup
||co.uk^$popup
! A generic @@||host^$popup exception removes the entry, its parents and its children.
||excepted-popup.example^$popup
||child.allowed-parent.example^$popup
@@||excepted-popup.example^$popup
@@||allowed-parent.example^$popup
! A site-scoped or a path exception does not: the entry stays.
||kept-popup.example^$popup
@@||kept-popup.example^$popup,domain=partner.example
@@||kept-popup.example/privacy-policy/*$popup
